glosses: to make an announcement by means of a public address system, to tannoy

examples.text: Als een trein aankomt wordt in het Oekraïens omgeroepen waar de passagiers zich kunnen melden.
examples.translation: Whenever a train arrives, an announcement is made in Ukrainian as to where the passengers can register.
examples.english: Whenever a train arrives, an announcement is made in Ukrainian as to where the passengers can register.

glosses: to make a public announcement in a loud voice, usually by a town crier

examples.text: Een Franſe Kaper heeft tot Jarmouth opgebracht een Vlieboot, groot 300 tonnen, met Sout geladen, komende van Liſſabon, en gaende na Teſſel: Den 15 dito liet den Kaper aldaer 't Sout door de Stadt omroepen, om te verkopen (...).
examples.translation: A French privateer has forced to Yarmouth a flyboat, size 300 tons, loaded with salt, coming from Lisbon and on course to Texel; on the 15th this month, the privateer had the salt announced [vocally] throughout the town in order to sell it (...)."
examples.english: A French privateer has forced to Yarmouth a flyboat, size 300 tons, loaded with salt, coming from Lisbon and on course to Texel; on the 15th this month, the privateer had the salt announced [vocally] throughout the town in order to sell it (...)."

examples.text: Te behandelen zaken: (...) Voorstel van den heer mr. Vos de Wael betreffende de invordering der retributies voor het aanplakken en omroepen van openbare aankondigingen.
examples.translation: Items to be discussed: (...) Proposal by Mr Vos de Wael concerning the collection of fees for the placarding and town-crying of public announcements.
examples.english: Items to be discussed: (...) Proposal by Mr Vos de Wael concerning the collection of fees for the placarding and town-crying of public announcements.

examples.text: In de winkel werd omgeroepen dat de speculaas in de aanbieding was.
